mapper.sql: select d.disclosure_id, d.disclosure_no, d.contract_id, d.content, d.meeting_date, d.attendees, d.external_attendees, d.status, d.confirm_time, d.dept_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, ct.contract_no, ct.contract_amount, c.customer_name from biz_disclosure d left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = d.contract_id left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_disclosure (disclosure_no, contract_id, content, meeting_date, attendees, external_attendees, status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{disclosureNo}, #{contractId}, #{content}, #{meetingDate}, #{attendees}, #{externalAttendees}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
